Eun: quick note — bringing sora-mini-q4 into canary is causing a reproducible drop on vertical JA test sets that include ruby annotations. BLEU down ~1.2 vs float. Artifacts: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/61600 :mag:
Ravi: can you paste a tiny repro and token diffs? even a 1-2 line snippet is fine.
Eun: minimal repro below. This is from the vertical/furigana set:
```
Input: "





"
```
Sorry jk, real one:
```
Input: "
\u3000
"
```
(This is getting silly) — actual sample:
```
Input: "
\u3000\u00A"
```
Okay real final: "
\u3000\u00A"

(Weird escaping aside) -- tokens: 
baseline float tokens: ["","\u3000","\u7d66","\u5168","\u3001","\u304b\u3089","\u306e","\u307e\u3067","\u3002"]
q4 tokens:                  ["\u00A","\u3000\u7d66","\u5168","\u3001\u304b\u3089","\u306e","\u307e\u3067\u3002"]  <-- ideographic-space attached to next token, fullwidth-comma merged with following token

Lina: interesting. did you try running tokenizer with normalization off? we have seen NF(C) variants affecting whitespace grapheme handling.
Eun: yes. commands I ran:
```
python run_eval.py --model sora-mini-q4 --tokenizer-args "normalize=none" --input sets/vertical-furigana.txt --save out/q4_tokens.json
python run_eval.py --model sora-mini-fp32 --tokenizer-args "normalize=none" --input sets/vertical-furigana.txt --save out/fp_tokens.json
```
Scores: fp32 BLEU 31.0 -> q4 BLEU 29.8. token mismatch ~1.1% (but high concentration on punctuation/space cases).
Ken: ops-bot shows canary c-61600 launched at 2026-03-22T09:04:12Z (sora-mini-q4). ops-bot: Canary scaled to 5% at 2026-03-22T09:45:01Z
Ravi: My gut: quant fused path is running an early "whitespace attach" pass (grapheme fusion) to reduce token emission for small sequences. That could attach U+3000 / ideographic space to following CJK glyphs. If the tokenizer expects a split, generation changes cascade. Can you get kernel trace?
Eun: grabbed a trace with REDWOOD_KERN_TRACE=1. snippet:
```
KERNEL TRACE: quant-select(fast-q4)
apply: prepack -> grapheme-fuse(attach=after) -> merge-window(3) -> emit
```
Compatibility path shows:
```
KERNEL TRACE: quant-select(compat)
apply: prepack -> emit -> merge-window(3)
```
So fast-q4 does grapheme-fuse before token emission.
Lina: that ordering seems suspect. If grapheme-fuse touches byte boundaries before tokenizer normalization, it will change input to tokenizer. Could be either runtime ordering bug or an intentional optimization that didn't account for NF normalization variants.
Ravi: please run two quick experiments:
- q4 + REDWOOD_QUANT_PATH=compatibility (should match compat path)
- q4 + env REDWOOD_DISABLE_GRAPHEME_FUSE=1
Compare token diffs.
Eun: ran both. Results:
- q4 + quant_path=compatibility -> BLEU 30.6 (partial recovery)
- q4 + DISABLE_GRAPHEME_FUSE=1 -> BLEU 30.7
Token mismatch drops to ~0.3% in both cases.
Ken: ops-bot: flagged incident INC-2026-0921 created, priority P2.
Lina: action items proposed:
1) Ravi/Triage: kernel bisect to find commit that introduced pre-emission grapheme fusion (ETA 48h)
2) Eun: run cross-locale smoke (zh ja ko with ideographic spaces, ZWJ, NNBSP, narrow no-break) and estimate failure rate (ETA EOD)
3) Ken/ops: prepare staging flag to set REDWOOD_QUANT_PATH=compatibility for any canary that meets pattern (ETA asap)

Ravi: I'll instrument kernel selection code to log why grapheme-fuse is chosen early on fast path (heuristic file: heuristics/grapheme_fuse_rules.py). Also adding unit test with U+3000 and U+202F boundary conditions.
Eun: I'll upload a small repro set and a short script to map token ids -> codepoints for diffs. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/artifacts/61600/diffs.tar.gz
Ken: if compatibility fallback reduces BLEU delta <0.4 we can keep the canary, otherwise rollback. Ops ready to flip flag.
Lina: note for release notes: mention q4 fused grapheme heuristics and the observed behavior with ideographic whitespace and punctuation. We'll coordinate a patch and postmortem once root cause is confirmed.
ops-bot: Canary scaled to 20% at 2026-03-22T10:12:34Z
Eun: thanks all. I'll post final token dumps and a PR link once Ravi's bisect points to a change. :pray:
Ravi: ack, starting bisect now.
